captions.detailed: A rugged mountain bike dropper post featuring a light grey outer alloy body and a contrasting black telescoping inner shaft. At the top of the shaft, a detailed clamp mechanism with metallic grey rail mounts secures a contoured black trail saddle. The inner shaft is designed to slide vertically inside the outer tube, mimicking a realistic prismatic suspension or seat-height adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate a mountain bike dropper post assembly in CadQuery. It should feature a light grey cylindrical outer body, a telescoping black inner shaft connected via a prismatic joint, and a detailed clamp head holding a contoured black saddle with metallic rail mounts.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject containing two primary moving parts connected by a prismatic joint. The base part consists of a light grey outer cylinder representing the lower post body. The sliding upper part is constructed from a black cylinder for the inner telescoping shaft, topped with a detailed clamp head, curved metallic rails, and a contoured saddle shape modeled using combined box and cylinder primitives.
